description: This file contains unit test framework functions for assertions and validation, such as assertEquals with various overloads, and a debug assertion. It defines helper functions to verify numerical and boolean conditions during testing.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM5(const char * prefix,const char * message,float expected,float actual,float EPS)
methods.description: Compares two floating point numbers with a specified epsilon, outputs message, and exits if the assertion fails.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM2(const char * msg,float expected,float actual,float eps)
methods.description: Simplified version of assertEqualsM5 with default epsilon.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM4(const char * prefix,const char * msg,float expected,float actual)
methods.description: Another version of assertEqualsM5 with a smaller, fixed epsilon.

methods.name: void assertEqualsLM(const char * msg,long expected,long actual)
methods.description: Compares two long integers, outputs message and exits on failure.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM(const char * msg,float expected,float actual)
methods.description: Basic float comparison with default epsilon.

methods.name: void chDbgAssert(int c,char * msg,void * arg)
methods.description: Debug assertion checking boolean condition, outputs message, and exits if false.

ctags.name: assertEqualsLM
ctags.pattern: /^void assertEqualsLM(const char *msg, long expected, long actual) {$/

ctags.name: assertEqualsM
ctags.pattern: /^void assertEqualsM(const char *msg, float expected, float actual) {$/

ctags.name: assertEqualsM2
ctags.pattern: /^void assertEqualsM2(const char *msg, float expected, float actual, float eps) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^void assertEqualsM4(const char *prefix, const char *msg, float expected, float actual) {$/
ctags.signature: (const char * prefix,const char * msg,float expected,float actual)
